extracted.name: Smoked Salmon Pizza
extracted.description: This smoked salmon pizza features store-bought crust, marinated artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes for a quick and easy appetizer or main dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup smoked salmon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
0.5 (6 ounce) jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Spread olive oil over pizza crust, then sprinkle with smoked salmon, artichokes, and sun-dried tomatoes. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese evenly over pizza.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly, 10 to 15 minutes.
